cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel my anniversary booking, will you? The number's on the fridge. I'll put these glasses away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's get the call done first. I'll find the booking number; you can do the talking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. If they offer another date?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I finish with the glasses; you needn't ask anything.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 allocates cancellation and glasses; A3 provides booking help while keeping B doing the painful speech; A5 asks for quiet presence rather than naming the emotional weight.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 why-question makes A3 defer explanation to the task; B4 rescheduling question causes A5 no-for-me and continued company.

relationship.evidence: B2 concern becomes B4 practical agreement without forcing disclosure.

heightening.evidence: A5 shifts from remote phone help to staying beside the aftermath of cancellation.

specificity.evidence: Anniversary booking, number and prepared glasses in A1 give the burden enough concrete context.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 asks B to convey one answer and stay quietly; each clause addresses what A cannot carry alone.
